title: Password Reset
description: User cannot reset password via link
resolution: Reset link was expired. Generated new password reset token and sent fresh email. Advised user to complete reset within 24 hours.

title: Account Locked
description: Account locked after multiple failed login attempts
resolution: Verified identity and unlocked account. Reset password and enabled two-factor authentication.

title: Suspicious Transaction
description: Customer reports unauthorized transaction on their account
resolution: Investigated transaction and confirmed it was fraudulent. Reversed charge, froze account, and issued new card.
